chunks: Those who disobey God and the Prophet and exceed the bounds of law, will be taken to Hell and abide there for ever and shall suffer despicable punishment.
ai.seo_question: What is the punishment for those who transgress Allah's limits?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to Surah 4:14, emphasizing that transgressing divine limits (hudud) involves both disobedience to Allah and the Prophet Muhammad. The 'humiliating punishment' (adhabun muhin) is interpreted not only as physical torment in Hell but also as the spiritual degradation of losing divine proximity. This serves as a warning for believers to maintain fidelity to the Ahl al-Bayt and the Prophetic tradition as the practical application of these limits.
